caption:
She was asked ONE question at the convenience store 🛍️

봉투 필요하세요? = Do you need a bag?
Answer: 네, 주세요 (yes please) / 아니요, 괜찮아요 (no thanks)

style_prefix: Black-and-white Japanese manga panel. Clean G-pen ink line art, solid black fills, halftone dot screentone shading, white paper. No color, no grey gradients, no text, no letters, no speech bubbles, no sound-effect lettering, no panel border.

panels.prompt: Low angle, full body. The girl from <image1> stands at a convenience store counter at night, holding one tiny banana-milk carton up in both hands like a precious treasure, eyes calm and serious. The magpie from <image2> sits on her shoulder, side-eyeing the carton. Fluorescent store shelves behind her in screentone. Leave the top third of the frame as plain white sky-like empty space for a title.

text.title: 봉투 필요하세요?
text.subtitle: Sora in Seoul · #1
text.hook: The cashier asked her ONE question.

panels.prompt: Wide establishing shot at night. A small 24-hour convenience store glowing on a quiet Seoul street corner, the glass sliding door open. The girl from <image1> steps inside, seen from behind and a little to the side, hands folded politely. Neon glow drawn as white light with dark screentone night sky. Empty space in the upper left.

Close-up of the counter. Two hands in hanbok sleeves (the sleeves from <image1>, dark cuff band) carefully place ONE tiny banana-milk carton in the exact center of the counter, like an offering at a ceremony. Small sparkle marks around the carton. Empty space at the top.

captions.en: One banana milk. That's all she needs.

panels.prompt: Medium shot of a bored young male convenience store cashier in a plain store vest behind the counter, half-lidded tired eyes, holding up a thin plastic shopping bag between two fingers. Simple shelves behind him. Empty space in the upper left for a speech balloon.

Extreme dramatic close-up of only the eyes and bangs of the girl from <image1>, wide and intensely serious, as if asked a life-or-death question. Dark heavy screentone shadow over the top of her face, radiating speed lines behind her, a single sweat drop. Intense shonen-manga drama.

captions.en: No one had ever asked her this before.

panels.prompt: Dramatic full-body splash. The girl from <image1> pulls a long silk wrapping cloth (a bojagi with a simple patchwork pattern) out of her wide hanbok sleeve in one grand sweeping flourish; the cloth billows in a huge arc across the frame. Shoujo-manga sparkles, flower blossoms and light rays explode in the background. Her face is calm and dignified. The magpie from <image2> perches on the counter in the foreground corner, staring flatly. Empty space in the top right.
Close-up of the hands of the girl from <image1> folding the corners of a silk patchwork wrapping cloth over a tiny milk carton on a store counter, with exaggerated care, motion lines on the fingers.

The girl from <image1> ties an elaborate decorative knot with total concentration, tongue slightly out, sparkles. On the counter the tiny milk carton has become a fancy wrapped gift with a big ornate bow, comically bigger than the carton.

The magpie from <image1> stands on the store counter next to the ornate wrapped gift, giving a slow, flat side-eye toward the viewer. Plain white background with a few subtle screentone dots. Lots of empty space on the left.

Wide shot pulled back. The girl from <image1> stands proudly at the counter holding her ornate wrapped gift. Behind her, a very long silent queue of exhausted office workers in suits snakes out the door, each holding a single item, faces in dark screentone shadow, completely deadpan. Empty space at the top.

Close-up of the bored young male convenience store cashier in a plain store vest, completely deadpan, dead eyes, a tiny sweat drop, slowly bowing his head. Plain background. Empty space in the upper right for a speech balloon.
